senses.gloss: (b. h.), Pi. רִדֵּד (cmp. יָרַד) [to lower,] to flatten, stamp, beat.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Moed Kattan 1:4">Tosef. M. Kat. I, 4</cite> <he>ומְרַדֵּד</he> (<cite ref="E00000"><he>ה</he></cite>)<he>אדמה וכ׳</he> (Var. <he>ומְרַדֵּיד</he>) and beats the ground under it (to kill the moles); Y. ib. I, 80ᶜ; Bab.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 7a:2">ib. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>ומְרַדֶּה</he> (Ms. M. <he>ומדדה</he>), v. <cite ref="T00241"><he>רָדָה</he> I</cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 6:3">Tam. VI, 3</cite> <he>התחיל מרדד ויוצא</he> (Bab. ed. 33ᵃ <he>מְרַדְּדָן</he>) he flattened (spread the heap of coals) and went out. Ib. 2 <he>ורְרָדָן בשולי וכ׳</he> (or <he>ורִרְּדָן</he>) and spread them with the rim of the pan.

<cite ref="Shabbat 103a:3">Sabb. 103ᵃ</cite> <he>מְרַרְּדֵי טסי משכן</he> those beating the gold foils for the Tabernacle; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 11:5">Tosef. ib. XI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 12:2">XII</cite>), 2; a. e.—Part. pass. <he>מְרוּדָּד</he>; pl. <he>מְרוּדָּדִין</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 7:5:2">Y. Erub. VII, 24ᶜ</cite> top <he>אם היה התבן מר׳</he> if the pile of straw is reduced (spread).
<cite ref="Chullin 46a:10">Ḥull. 46ᵃ</cite> <he>כזית מר׳</he> if the olive’s size that is left of the liver looks like beaten (ragged).
<cite ref="Chullin 124b">Ib. 124ᵇ</cite> <he>במר׳</he> when the piece of meat is ragged (the two parts, each of half an olive’s size, connected by a strip).

<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 7:7">Mikv. VII, 7</cite> <he>מקוה שמימיו מר׳</he> a bathing tank the water of which is shallow (and spread, and can be made deeper by damming). Ohol. VII, 2 <he>מקצתו מר׳ על הארץ</he> part of the tent canvas flat on the ground; <he>מר׳ על הארובה</he> stretched flat over the sky-light.
